We have functional groups list. Use "ketones" and "C-C double bonds". For alcohol formed: "aliphatic hydroxyls". So search.

We need the target molecule SMILES. Provided as mapped with atom mapping: [CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]

We need plain SMILES without mapping. Let's convert: CH2= C( aromatic ring ) C@@H1CH2CH2CH2C@@1(OH)C(F)(F)F. The aromatic part is c1ccccc1 attached to the C (the double bond carbon). So overall SMILES: C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CC C C1(OH)C(F)(F)F. Need correct: C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC[C@@]1(O)C(F)(F)F? The stereochemistry maybe not needed. Use generic: C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC[C]1(O)C(F)(F)F. Let's just use: C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC[C]1(O)C(F)(F)F. Might be okay.

Now search template.
